evals, judges and computer time) in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n- [Set the organization's spen
d budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set or replace the ceiling. **Requ
ires organization owner or admin.**\n- [Remove the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remo
ve-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n- [List organiz
ations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to: the source
of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and
only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.\n- [List projec
ts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-projects.md): Projects the caller can access. API keys only ever see projec
ts inside the key's organization.\n- [List a project's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-serv
ers.md): The MCP servers saved in the project: the `serverId`s every other route takes. STDIO command/args/env and raw headers are
never exposed.\n- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): E
val suites in the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.\n- [List chat s
essions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-chat-sessions.md): Chat sessions visible to the caller (personal + pro
ject-shared merged). Top-level rather than project-nested because `projectId` is an optional filter, not an owning scope.\n- [The
MCPJam-provided model catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/the-mcpjam-provided-model-catalog.md): PUBLIC: this r
oute carries no user or project data and requires no bearer token.\n- [Export project traces as OTLP/JSON](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/catalog/export-project-traces-as-otlpjson.md): Returns an OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest`. Pagination rides in RES
PONSE HEADERS rather than the body so the payload stays a valid OTLP document: read `x-mcpjam-next-cursor` and feed it back as `cu
rsor`, and treat `x-mcpjam-export-complete: true` as the end of the stream.\n- [List a project's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the project: the named, reusable configurations that defin
e how MCPJam connects to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s and `configId`s the detail and write routes take. Client
s that exist only as the private backing of a User Testing study are omitted unless `includ…\n- [Create a client (from a template
or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-template-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a c
lient in the project and responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the config one of two ways: pass `template` (a built-in
template id, optional `theme`) to seed server-side from the live client-template catalog, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog
snapshot if the live catalog…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full
settings, including its resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact`: what a config ed
it would follow. The path segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads a
s `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the
client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: the error names what to detach f
irst. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md):
Edit a client's display name and/or its config. Two ways to change the config: `config` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes n
amed fields over the config read inside the write transaction. Prefer `set`, because a whole-config round-trip composed from a sta
le read reverts whatever landed in betwe…\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-
clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's required and optional saved-server attachments without round-tripping the whole config.
Composed server-side from the client's current config, so every other setting is preserved, and `expectedConfigId` is required so
two concurrent server replacements cannot silently lose one.\n- [Duplicate a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/client
s/duplicate-a-client.md): Creates a new client carrying the selected client's current config, and responds `201` with the copy's d
etail. Purely additive: the source is untouched.\n- [Validate a server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/v
alidate-a-server.md): Connects to the server, initializes the MCP session, and returns a connection snapshot (server info, negotia
ted capabilities). The same check the hosted inspector runs when you connect a server.\n- [Run the doctor](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/server-diagnostics/run-the-doctor.md): Runs the full doctor workflow (probe → connect → initialize → capabilities →
primitives) and returns a step-by-step report. The richest signal for \"is this server healthy, and why not.\"\n- [Check OAuth re
quirement](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/check-oauth-requirement.md): Lightweight, no MCP connection: r
eports whether the server is configured to require an OAuth grant.\n- [List tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitive
s/list-tools.md): Returns the server's tools as a collection page. Each item is the MCP tool definition (`name`, `description`, `i
nputSchema`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-prompts.md): Returns the server's promp
ts as a collection page.\n- [List resources](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-resources.md): Returns the serv
er's resources as a collection page.\n- [Read a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-resource.md): Re
ads a single resource by URI and returns its contents.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/li
st-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skill
s it advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, because duplicate detection spans
the whole listing.\n- [Get a server skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/get-a-server-skill.md): Fetches one s
kill by URI and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the manifest, the fetched frontmatter against wha
t the listing advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial listing never mentioned. When a check fails the r
